about_the_game:
Game Demo Introduction

Inside Qingxuan Temple, Li Erniu was informed that he was about to become the husband of the head of Huanhong Sect.

But as soon as the portrait was opened, a voice of despair rang out.

Why would the leader of the Huanghuan sect be so despicable as to be utterly abhorrent? ！

That very night, Li Erniu rushed out of Qingxuan Temple to elope.

But on the way down the mountain, I ran into Han - the extremely powerful Master Sister - Ziyuan, who had been waiting here all along.

Should one return to the Huanghuan Sect to become a subordinate, or should one protect one's own virginity?

Li Erniu found himself in a dilemma...

Character Introduction in the Demo

The character played by the player was adopted by the villagers from the mountain when he was young and brought up in Qingxuan Temple.

He was the only male among the people in Qingxuan Temple. He was sold to the leader of Huanghuan Sect at a high price of ten taels of gold as a concubine.

The humanoid system of "Li Erniu's Brave Adventure in Huanghuan General's Mansion".

The system claiming to be Li Erniu will assist Li Erniu in conquering various cute girls (?) 。

Master Sister of Qingxuan Temple, your combat skills are absolutely outstanding.

It is the white moonlight of the entire Qingxuan Temple, the backbone of all the people.

Claiming to be a servant of the chief of the Peony Sect, she came to visit the future husband of the sect leader.

Instead, it unexpectedly helped you out of your predicament.

Xingxuan Temple's young novice sister is only 16 years old.

Having a fiery personality, one of the followers of the senior sister, but...

Production Team

Production Team：Yoyozi Studio

Producer/Script: Yoyozi

Lead Designer / Animation / UI: Amin

Program: Xiangzi

Voice Director: HoYin

Voice actors: Yi, Liuyao, Qingluo, Shuyunjian

Operation: Youyouzi

Game mechanics

This is a text-based adventure game presented from the first-person perspective, with the protagonist being a male.

You need to uncover the truth by having conversations with various cute girls.

By choosing different options, different events will be triggered, and finally, the suitable ending for you will be determined.

This game is only available in Chinese and the game mode is single-player.

Demo version content introduction

It involves the opening scene of the main storyline. 5+ story maps are available for players to unlock and collect.

Multiple unlockable side story branches and endings are available.

The branching options are not all fully unlocked. They are related to the main storyline and require the player to discover the truth on their own.

Sound effects

Full Chinese voiceover. Customized voiceovers for all female characters, aiming to provide the best experience for players.

A large number of BGM music, in line with the movie-level coordination with the visuals, presents the best gaming experience.

Dynamic effect

The key CG images present dynamic effects, enhancing the players' immersion while striving for even better artistic quality.

Different scenes incorporate various dynamic effects, enhancing the players' sense of immersion.

Art Design

A large number of character expressions changes and plot diagrams interludes make players not feel bored while playing.

Drawing inspiration from the designs of ancient fantasy stories, we aim to create distinct styles for each female character.

At the same time, we have added some small Easter eggs in the scene map for players to discover.

Creation Statement

It seems to be the result of the producer going crazy in the process of creation, emphasizing abstraction and self-expression.

The product was refined over a period of 4 months, but it also made every effort to strive for even better results within its capabilities.

Artwork involves AI. We really can't handle it. (Kneels)

However, after engaging in as much back-and-forth communication with AI as possible, a delicate balance was eventually achieved.

It's hard to say how many people will like it, but we hope you know that we were here...
